messages.subject: change 3838 port
parts:
Hi,

I'd like to change port 3838 of my shiny server, so I read couple of times the Administrator Guide (http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#host-a-directory-of-applications-1).
But when I change the line that instructs my server to listen to port 3838, in /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf (that I have created), I obtain the following message : start: Unknown job: shiny-server
I have CentOS 6 and Shiny Server Open Source Edition.

Thanks!
Thomas Brand

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: change 3838 port
parts:
Thomas,

Sorry if you are already doing this, but just to make sure, you need to run the following commands to stop and start the server:

sudo stop shiny-server
sudo start shiny-server

If you are running these, and are getting error, please send us the following files:

/etc/init/shiny-server.conf
/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf

And also the version of Shiny Server that you are running.

Best,
Fereshteh
